svg.title: AkidaTag system block diagram, hardware revision 2
svg.text: 5 x TPS22991 load switches, 2 x INA190 current sense
feed-through: the host reaches IC2 through the AKD1500
Both flashes are 128 Mbit SPI NOR;
IC1 single-lane from the host, IC2 quad from the AKD1500
Firmware update slot, LittleFS records and the AKD1500 model
program all live in external flash; the nRF5340 boots from internal flash
Power enables from the nRF5340: P0.19 (AKD1500 1.8 V), P0.20 (IMU), P0.21 (microphones), P0.22 (AKD1500 0.8 V), P1.06 (camera header)
Current sense outputs into the nRF5340 ADC: AIN0 (1.8 V rail), AIN1 (0.8 V rail)
Drawn from the revision 2 netlist and bill of materials. Changes from the earlier board: camera header instead of a 20-pin expansion connector,
one button and an on/off switch instead of three buttons, a 10-pin SWD header, on-board current sensing, and the U.FL connector left unfitted.
